Run the geothermal long enough and it §6scales up§r: the thicker the scale, the thinner the steam — neglect it and the well nearly stops. The fix is easy: sneak right-click the controller with an empty hand and scrape it clean on the spot.

There is also an §6overpressure§r trick: push heat past the red line and output climbs hard — double, if you dare. Just make sure the water supply keeps up before playing with fire.

§cScale is a time tax; come scrape often.§r
